$description: Per-theme mega-menu colors for the design file's Mega-menu board, synced to its Light and Dark modes by npm run figcraft:tokens. They live here, not only in the design file, so the repo stays the source. Names are used verbatim, NOT under the color.* prefix. src/assets/css/local/main-nav.css computes these live with color-mix(); the hexes below are the flattened result and drift if the palette moves. megamenu.icon is a link to megamenu.count, since the icons rest in the count color. Two colors the panel uses are deliberately absent because they are already real tokens: color.text and color.orange.500.
